title: GPT-6 Astra needs leaner prompts and fewer guardrails, OpenAI recommends
summary: Overly long skill descriptions, blanket reading requirements, and rigid approval rules can get in GPT-6 Astra's way, warns OpenAI's Eric Provencher.
